_: The Instagram Story path cannot be rehearsed - Instagram has no unpublished state, so the first one is live. This card exists to be that first one. Deliberately inconsequential: no figures, no dates, no deadline, nothing anyone could act on wrongly. If it breaks, nothing was riding on it. First card of the Titan and Echo series.
headline:
Titan And Echo
Will Take It From Here
titan_line: Echo, from here on we handle the updates. What is happening around the county, what the numbers actually did, and the bits of a house nobody thinks about until they leak.
echo_line: And when I don't follow something, I'll say so. If it takes me two goes, it probably takes someone else two goes.
